newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica shares jump before Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica shares jump before Q1 results.

text.p: Spanish telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana shares jumped on Monday, outpacing the market, before the release of what are expected to be good first-quarter results.
"People are betting on results that are even better than forecast, although the 4,000 peseta zone could prompt sales short-term," a bank dealer said.

At 1030 GMT, Telefonica shares were up 85 pesetas, or 2.17 percent, at 3,995, having earlier set a new high of 4,010. The IBEX-35 index of leading shares was up 68.67 points, or 1.1 percent, at 6,195.52.
The market was forecasting a rise of 20 percent in first-quarter earnings, which are expected shortly.
